catalysts.name: Vertiv Holdings Co
catalysts.what: Q3 2026 net sales $4,312.8M (+61% y/y) vs ~$3.75B consensus; diluted EPS +91% to $1.95, adjusted diluted EPS +78% to $2.21. Raised FY2026 guidance to $14,450–14,850M net sales (from ~$14.0B) and $7.10–$7.20 adjusted diluted EPS (from $6.65–6.75), citing accelerating AI data-center demand and organic orders more than doubling y/y.

catalysts.name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
catalysts.what: Q3 2026: revenue $5.1B (+36% y/y, beat ~$4.56B consensus); non-GAAP diluted EPS $20.07 vs ~$16.19 consensus (+70% y/y). Sanofi-reported Dupixent sales +35% y/y to $6.5B (Regeneron now books its full profit share); EYLEA HD US sales +62% y/y to $699M, with FY2026 EYLEA HD sales guided to grow >50% y/y even as original EYLEA faces biosimilar pressure. Expanded Sanofi collaboration adds a $1.0B upfront payment (booked Q4 2026) plus up to $7.0B in milestones. Shares hit a new 52-week high, +11–13% on the day across sources.

VRT.what: Digital-infrastructure supplier (Liebert, NetSure, Geist): power management, thermal control and rack/IT systems for AI data centers, communications networks and industrial customers.

REGN.what: Biopharmaceutical: Eylea/Eylea HD (wet AMD, diabetic eye disease), Dupixent (atopic dermatitis, asthma; profit-shared with Sanofi), plus Libtayo, Praluent and a broadening oncology/rare-disease pipeline.

notices: No new catalyst alerts qualified this run. VRT (28 Oct) and REGN (30 Oct) are carried over and re-priced, still inside the rolling 5-session window (28 Oct–3 Nov). SOFI (27 Oct) dropped out of that window today and was removed as stale, not rejected on the merits.

Checked four fresh candidates and none cleared the bar — see rejected: AMD and Super Micro Computer's 3 Nov earnings had confirmed beats, but their guidance-raise figures didn't reconcile across sources; Bloom Energy's reported analyst rating action was contradicted between two sources; Exelixis's raised target implies only ~8% upside, below the 15% threshold.

QQQ (NDX proxy): WebSearch found two independent sources (stockanalysis.com, Finviz) agreeing on Tuesday's (3 Nov) close of $685.28, +0.62% — used as an approximate, search-sourced quote.
rejected: AMD · Q3 2026 results reported 3 Nov: revenue and EPS beat confirmed across sources (revenue in the $13–13.4B area, Data Center +97% y/y), but the specific claim of a Q4 guide ~$770M above consensus could not be reconciled — one secondary aggregator cited that figure while SEC-adjacent coverage only gave the raw Q4 guide (~$17B) with no comparable consensus to confirm a beat. Dropped for insufficient two-source reconciliation on the guidance-raise claim.

Super Micro Computer (SMCI) · fiscal Q1 FY2027 results/call held 3 Nov. The company's sharply raised preliminary figures were pre-announced 20 Oct, outside this run's 5-session catalyst window, and no reconcilable second source confirmed a fresh guidance raise specific to the 3 Nov print itself. Dropped pending clearer, dated sourcing.

Bloom Energy (BE) · one source described a Barclays upgrade to Overweight (target $289, cut from $316); a second, more detailed source said Barclays kept Equal Weight and simply raised its target to $316 from $308 — the two accounts contradict each other on the rating action itself. Dropped per the cross-check rule.

Exelixis (EXEL) · HC Wainwright raised its target to $78 from $56 (Buy maintained) after the stock hit a new 52-week high, but the implied upside versus the live FMP price (~$72.31) is only ~8%, below the >15% threshold required for an analyst-upgrade catalyst. Dropped.
SoFi (SOFI) · previously published Earnings beat + raise alert (27 Oct) is now outside the rolling last-5-trading-session window (28 Oct–3 Nov). Removed as stale, not a market-outcome rejection.
